newsitem.title: UK: AVIS EUROPE SAYS YR PRE-TAX PROFIT UP 20 PCT.
newsitem.headline: AVIS EUROPE SAYS YR PRE-TAX PROFIT UP 20 PCT.

text.p: Car rental group ~Avis Europe said on Monday that profit before interest, exceptional items and tax for the year ended February 28 was 101.5 million stg. Pre-tax profit was 57.0 million stg.

Avis Europe is due to list part of its capital in London later this month. The company is 77.1 percent held by leading Belgian car importer and distributor D'Ieteren NV which plans to remain the majority shareholder in Avis Europe.
Avis Europe said earnings for the year had increased 305 percent to 40.1 million stg from 9.9 million stg.

"We are looking forward to our financial strength being further boosted by access to additional funds to repay debt and for investment in the business through our flotation on the London Stock Exchange," chairman Alun Cathcart said in a statement.
In addition to repaying debt and helping to develop rental activities, the float will also pay for a buy-back of General Motors stake in Avis Europe.
The group said admission to the London exchange and unconditional dealings were expected to begin on April 4. The announcement of the final offer price is expected on March 26.
The 215 million share issue is expected to raise around 237 million stg, giving Avis Europe a market capitalisation of between 629 and 734 million stg.
